mapper.sql: a.id, a.user_id AS userId, a.schedule_id AS scheduleId, d.id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, dept.id AS departmentId, dept.name AS departmentName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.time_slot AS timeSlot, a.patient_name AS patientName, a.patient_phone AS patientPhone, a.amount, a.pay_method AS payMethod, a.pay_time AS payTime, a.status, a.remark, a.create_time AS createTime, a.update_time AS updateTime
FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN schedule s ON a.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON s.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN department dept ON d.department_id = dept.id

where.if: AND (a.patient_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR a.patient_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY s.schedule_date DESC, s.time_slot DESC, a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment a SET status = 'checked_in', check_in_time = NOW(6) WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM schedule s WHERE s.id = a.schedule_id AND s.schedule_date = CURDATE() AND s.status = 1)
